answer: Clone cost is market impact: the book records one signal per serial clearing and gives a head weight only when one unsplit trade burns k² umber yet still leaves delta of k ticks, where k is its rank among heads fed by the same umber source. A clean newcomer is rank 1. Splitting lowers delta; batching is ordered. n co-fed clones therefore burn 1²+…+n² umber, and outside umber is a bribe, not a clone.
